copy.title: ACT Landscape Construction — Landscaping, Pools & Sports Courts, Canberra
copy.description: Pools, sports courts, decks, walls, paving and gardens across Canberra and Queanbeyan, designed and built by one team from our Fyshwick showroom. With ACT Decks, 2025 Master Builders ACT winners, Landscape Design and Construction Residential.
copy.headline:
Pool. Court.
Deck. Garden.
One team.
copy.sub: We're a team of 14 in Fyshwick, led by Director Xavier Duffy, and we design and build whole backyards with every trade managed in-house. This is the Jerrabomberra backyard we built with ACT Decks: a 2025 Master Builders ACT award winner.
copy.statementBody: No lining up a pool builder, a court company, a deck builder and a landscaper yourself. We manage the design, approvals, excavation, construction and the final detail in-house, with mini excavators, tippers and skid steers on the job. You deal with one team from the first conversation to handover.
copy.servicesIntro: Each part is planned around the rest: how the pool meets the paving and the deck, how a court sits into the levels and the drainage, how the planting ties it together. Built for Canberra's frosty winters and hot, dry summers.
copy.apertureLine: Deck, pool, lawn and court. One backyard.
copy.workIntro: A grass tennis court in Forrest, corten screens, a pool with its own spa, a courtyard plunge pool, a brick path through grasses, and an outdoor kitchen under a pergola. Every photo on this page is our own. Select any photo to see it larger.
copy.processIntro: How every job runs, from the first conversation to walking you through the finished space.
copy.recognitionIntro: Master Builders ACT, our Fyshwick showroom and Harvest Pools: three things you can look up before you ring.
copy.reviewsIntro: From our Google reviews, word for word. Two of the three below run longer on Google and are marked shortened.
copy.areasIntro: From our showroom in Fyshwick, we work across Canberra, Queanbeyan and the surrounding areas. Recent jobs include a whole backyard in Forrest, retaining walls and paving in Kaleen, and the Jerrabomberra backyard we built with ACT Decks, a 2025 Master Builders ACT award winner.

process.detail: A quick conversation about your goals, ideas, budget and timeline, then we meet on site or virtually to assess the space and give you honest advice on what's possible.
Design concepts, material selections, a scope of works and transparent pricing, so you know exactly what you're getting.

Our in-house team builds it with quality control and respect for your home, then walks you through the finished space to make sure every detail is right.

reviews.text: The team at ACT Landscaping provided outstanding support in designing a comprehensive backyard makeover. This project incorporated a new patio featuring an outdoor kitchen, a Pool House, and landscaping for the garden and pool.

faq.q: What does a job like this cost?
faq.a: It depends on the size of your block, the scope of work and the materials you choose. We quote after an on-site consultation, with the design, materials, scope of works and pricing set out clearly, so you know exactly what you're getting.

We don't do quick patch jobs, low-cost shortcuts or one-size-fits-all packages. But it doesn't have to be a full property overhaul: a smaller upgrade is fine, and one of the reviews on this page is for a single retaining wall.

Yes. For pools we handle the required approvals and make sure the installation meets ACT regulations and safety standards. Some retaining walls need approval depending on their height and location, and we build to the local regulations.

faq.q: Can I see the materials before I commit?
faq.a: Yes. Book a time at the Fyshwick showroom to compare paving, stone, decking, pool coping and cabinetry finishes side by side, look at the pergola and outdoor kitchen displays, and go through your plans in the meeting room.

faq.q: Do you work on new builds?
faq.a: Yes. We work with homeowners, builders and developers on new builds, as well as renovations and complete backyard upgrades.
Yes. We operate with the licensing and insurance required for landscaping and structural outdoor works.
